action.description: Operation: 'status' (read-only), reversible agent controls ('pause'/'resume', 'block'/'unblock', 'set_policy', 'emergency_halt'/'emergency_resume'), or 'revoke_locks' (irreversibly drops locks).
action.title: Action

admin_token.description: Secret matching TOKEN_CONTEXT_ADMIN_TOKEN env var; required for every action except 'status' (denied if unset or mismatched).
admin_token.title: Admin Token

agent_id.description: Target agent ID (required for pause/resume/block/unblock/set_policy; optional for revoke_locks where None revokes all locks; cannot pause/block 'admin').
agent_id.title: Agent Id

custom_tools.description: Non-empty list of permitted tool names required when action='set_policy' and policy='CUSTOM'.
custom_tools.title: Custom Tools

policy.description: Required when action='set_policy': 'FULL_ACCESS', 'READ_ONLY', or 'CUSTOM' (with non-empty custom_tools).
policy.title: Policy

reason.description: Human-readable justification persisted in governance state and audit_logs for mutating actions.
reason.title: Reason

agent_id.description: Exact caller agent_id filter (e.g. 'anonymous' or worker ID); omit to return logs across all agents.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

limit.description: Maximum audit records returned newest-first from audit.sqlite (default 50).
limit.title: Limit

status.description: Outcome filter: 'SUCCESS', 'DENIED' (policy/token rejection), or 'ERROR'; omit to include all outcomes.
status.title: Status

limit.description: Maximum matches to return (1 to max_symbol_results; defaults to 'locate' profile or server cap, reporting excess in omitted_count).
limit.title: Limit

max_tokens.description: Token cap for the response (32 to max_result_tokens); defaults to 'locate' profile budget.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

pattern.description: Symbol name or qualified-name pattern (supports '*' and '?' wildcards; exact matches rank first).
pattern.title: Pattern

profile.description: Named budget profile preset ('locate', 'orient', 'impact', 'read'); defaults to 'locate'.
profile.title: Profile

repo_id.description: Registered repository ID from list_repositories (never a filesystem path).

include_private.description: Include private/internal symbols (leading underscore or non-exported) when True; defaults to public declarations only.

max_tokens.description: Token cap for skeleton entries (32 to max_result_tokens; defaults to 'read' profile budget, truncating tail entries).

path.description: Indexed repository-relative file path (rejects denied secrets/paths and returns error if unindexed).

depth.description: Maximum AST call-graph hops (0 to 3; defaults to 2 under 'impact' profile; out-of-range errors).
depth.title: Depth

filter_ambiguous.description: Exclude edges with status='ambiguous' (multiple matching targets) when True; set False to inspect uncertain candidates.
filter_ambiguous.title: Filter Ambiguous

max_nodes.description: Hard cap on visited graph nodes before setting node_limit_reached=true (1 to max_graph_nodes).
max_nodes.title: Max Nodes

max_tokens.description: Token cap for serialized slice (32 to max_result_tokens; defaults to 'impact' profile budget).
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

min_confidence.description: Optional edge confidence floor (0.0 to 1.0) filtering out weaker lexical call guesses.

symbol_id.title: Symbol Id

repo_id.description: Registered repository ID from list_repositories (never a filesystem path; returns unknown_repo_id if unregistered).
repo_id.title: Repo Id

verbose.description: Include full diagnostic metadata (role_counts, entry_points, derived_defaults, added_paths, edge_precision); defaults to False for compact status.
verbose.title: Verbose

max_tokens.description: Token cap for the response (32 to max_result_tokens); defaults to 'impact' profile budget and reports omissions in omitted_count.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

module.description: Module/package name (1-200 safe chars); pass exactly one of path or module (providing both or neither errors).
module.title: Module

path.description: Indexed repository-relative file path; pass exactly one of path or module (providing both or neither errors).
path.title: Path

profile.description: Named budget profile preset ('locate', 'orient', 'impact', 'read'); defaults to 'impact'.

budget_tokens.description: Token cap for the response (32 to max_result_tokens); defaults to 'orient' profile (1024) and sets truncated=true if symbols are omitted.
budget_tokens.title: Budget Tokens

format.description: Entry detail: 'compact' returns [id, path:line, kind/name] tuples; 'grouped' maps path to compact lines; 'full' returns full symbol objects, signatures, and evidence.
format.title: Format

include_digests.description: Include per-file 12-char SHA-256 file_digests map in compact or grouped mode (defaults to False).
include_digests.title: Include Digests

include_omitted_ids.description: Include up to 10 truncated symbol IDs in omitted_symbol_ids for targeted follow-ups.
include_omitted_ids.title: Include Omitted Ids

include_tests.description: Include test files and test symbols in ranking when True; defaults to False to prioritize production code.
include_tests.title: Include Tests

profile.description: Named budget profile preset ('locate', 'orient', 'impact', 'read'); explicit args override profile defaults (defaults to 'orient').
profile.title: Profile

query.description: Optional symbol/topic terms that switch rank_mode from global centrality to seed-biased personalized graph ranking.

repo_id.description: Registered repository ID from list_repositories (never a filesystem path; errors with unknown_repo_id if unregistered).
repo_id.title: Repo Id

body_offset_line.description: 1-based line offset inside the symbol body to read oversized functions in pages via body_window.next_offset.
body_offset_line.title: Body Offset Line

depth.description: Neighborhood traversal depth around the target symbol (0 for target only, up to 3 hops).
depth.title: Depth

include_body.description: Include target symbol body; defaults to True in 'read' profile. If body exceeds budget, emits root_body_hint.
include_body.title: Include Body

include_omitted_ids.description: Include up to 10 truncated neighbor IDs in omitted_symbol_ids when neighbors exceed max_tokens.
include_omitted_ids.title: Include Omitted Ids

max_tokens.description: Token cap for packet and neighbors (32 to max_result_tokens; defaults to 'read' profile budget).
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

symbol_id.title: Symbol Id

tool_name.description: Exact name of an enabled MCP tool (disabled or unknown names return status='not_found' plus available_tools).
tool_name.title: Tool Name

budget_tokens.description: Total token cap (clamped to 256..8192); splits budget between body and relationships and sets retry_hint if body is clipped.
budget_tokens.title: Budget Tokens

query.description: Exact or wildcard symbol name to resolve (prefers unique exact match; returns up to 5 candidates if ambiguous).
query.title: Query

repo_id.title: Repo Id

view.description: Detail level: 'minimal' (signature + 3-tuple edges), 'normal' (adds body + edge dicts), 'full' (context packet with callers/callees/tests).
view.title: View

namespace.description: Optional namespace to scope both synthesis and pruning; omit (None) to consolidate every namespace in scope.
namespace.title: Namespace

prune_transient.description: When True, permanently deletes consolidated source entries from their origin scope/namespace; defaults to False (non-destructive).
prune_transient.title: Prune Transient

scope.description: Source scope to read up to 500 oldest active entries from ('session', 'project', or 'global').
scope.title: Scope

target_key.description: Destination key in 'global' scope (ttl=None); overwrites existing summary and excludes itself from source entries.
target_key.title: Target Key

key.description: Exact key previously written with memory_put (non-empty).
key.title: Key

namespace.description: Exact namespace used at write time; returns status='not_found' if mismatched.
namespace.title: Namespace

scope.description: Persistence tier where the entry was stored ('session', 'project', or 'global').
scope.title: Scope

session_id.description: Optional session tag used as fallback namespace when scope='session' and namespace is empty.
session_id.title: Session Id

agent_id.description: Validated caller agent identifier owning the lease (non-empty; rejected identities fail governance check).
agent_id.title: Agent Id

resource_key.description: Non-empty resource or file key to lock exclusively; re-entrant/renewable when already held by the same agent_id.
resource_key.title: Resource Key

timeout_sec.description: Lease TTL in seconds after which another agent can acquire the lock automatically (default 60).
timeout_sec.title: Timeout Sec

key.description: Non-empty key (<= 256 UTF-8 bytes) identifying the entry; overwrites any existing entry with the same (scope, namespace, key).
key.title: Key

namespace.description: Isolation bucket (e.g. agent or task ID); defaults to session_id or '' under 'session' scope and must match on memory_get.
namespace.title: Namespace

scope.description: Persistence tier: 'session' (isolated by namespace/session_id), 'project' (repo-level), or 'global' (shared across projects).
scope.title: Scope

session_id.description: Optional session tag; used as fallback namespace when scope='session' and namespace is empty.
session_id.title: Session Id

ttl.description: Lifetime in seconds before expiry (default 86400; pass None or <= 0 to persist indefinitely until overwritten/pruned).
ttl.title: Ttl

value.description: JSON-serializable value (<= 1 MB serialized; common secret tokens are automatically redacted before storage).
value.title: Value

limit.description: Maximum active entries to return after BM25 ranking (default 5).
limit.title: Limit

namespace.description: Restrict results to one namespace; omit to search across all namespaces.
namespace.title: Namespace

query.description: Non-empty FTS5 keywords matched across stored keys and serialized values (invalid syntax safely yields 0 matches + warning).
query.title: Query

scope.description: Restrict results to 'session', 'project', or 'global'; omit to search across all scopes.
scope.title: Scope

agent_id.description: Owner agent_id; release succeeds only if it matches the active lock holder, otherwise returns status='not_locked'.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

resource_key.description: Resource identifier previously passed to memory_lock.
resource_key.title: Resource Key

intent.description: Compression focus guiding extraction and symbol retention (e.g. 'general_code_summary', 'call_flow', 'error_analysis').
intent.title: Intent

max_tokens.description: Generation token budget passed to local Ollama when active (default 512).
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

target_symbols.description: Symbol names that must be preserved verbatim and tracked in symbol_coverage_rate.
target_symbols.title: Target Symbols

text.description: Raw code or verbose tool output to compress (first 3000 chars prioritized in hybrid context extraction).
text.title: Text

expand.description: Neighbor expansion: 'auto' (graph under 'locate' profile, none otherwise), 'none', or 'graph' (adds top-k callers/callees).
expand.title: Expand

expand_hops.description: Call-graph traversal hops from each expanded seed hit (1 or 2).
expand_hops.title: Expand Hops

expand_k.description: Number of top search hits used as seeds for graph neighbor expansion (1 to 8).
expand_k.title: Expand K

limit.description: Maximum symbol hits to return before token packing (1 to 100; defaults to 'locate' profile limit).
limit.title: Limit

max_tokens.description: Token cap for hits plus expanded neighbors (32 to max_result_tokens; defaults to 'locate' profile budget).
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

min_confidence.description: Minimum AST/lexical edge confidence (0.0 to 1.0) required to include an expanded neighbor.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

profile.description: Budget profile ('locate', 'orient', 'impact', 'read'); 'locate' defaults expand='graph', others default expand='none'.
profile.title: Profile

query.description: Space-separated FTS5 keywords or code identifiers (runs AND query first, topped up with OR if sparse).
query.title: Query

repo_id.description: Registered repository ID from list_repositories (never a filesystem path).
repo_id.title: Repo Id

limit.description: Maximum ranked tools to return (ordered by descending relevance_score, default 3).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Task or capability keywords matched against enabled tool names, tags, and summaries.
query.title: Query

agent_id.description: Optional recording agent ID stored for attribution and per-agent write rate limits.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

answers.description: Source-verified symbol citations formatted as '<symbol_id>@<line>'; at least one must pass verification or card is rejected.
answers.title: Answers

decoys.description: Optional false-positive symbols formatted as '<symbol_id>!<reason_code>' to down-rank in future searches.
decoys.title: Decoys

query.description: Task or question whose indexable terms build the lookup signature (errors with empty_signature if no tokens remain).
query.title: Query

repo_id.title: Repo Id

steps.description: Optional verified multi-hop edges formatted as '<from_id>><to_id>@<line>' linking traversal paths.
